title: Scope Hash Calculation
description: Calculates the canonical semantic scope identity for an approved candidate action without granting authority.
intent: Canonicalize task, repository, base, branch, head, risk, path, action, exclusion, and binding inputs into one deterministic scope identity, failing closed for malformed, ambiguous, conflicting, overbroad, unbound, empty, or self-referential write scope.
outcome: GateScopeIdentity with READY or BLOCKED outcome, deterministic reason_codes, canonical scope_hash only when READY, null scope_hash when BLOCKED, and authority_granted=false.
constraints: The evaluator is pure and deterministic for the same semantic inputs; calculated_at is diagnostic and never part of the hash.
Equivalent normalized semantic scope must produce the same scope_hash; material changes to task, repository, base, head, risk, paths, actions, exclusions, or bindings must change it.
For merge_approved_pr, .gwc/tasks/<task-id>/g4/** is evidence about the approval subject and MUST NOT be hashed back into that subject; such input fails closed with SCOPE_SELF_REFERENCE.

The action vocabulary and additional binding keys are closed; unknown values, authorized/excluded conflicts, invalid paths, root wildcards, missing branch/head bindings, empty write scope, and G4 evidence self-reference fail closed.
A BLOCKED result must not expose a usable scope_hash, and scope identity never grants G2, G4, G5, G6, merge, deploy, release, credential, migration, or production-data authority.
exclusions: Granting or validating human approval or gate authority.
Reading or mutating repositories, Jira, GitHub, branches, worktrees, PRs, deployments, releases, credentials, migrations, or production data.
Treating a scope digest as an approval, bypassing current base/head/scope binding, or accepting projection-only task status as canonical evidence.
Treating a G4 evidence-container commit as part of the semantic approval subject it records.
entry_guards: task, repository, base_ref, and base_sha are present
candidate paths, actions, exclusions, and additional bindings are supplied as bounded semantic inputs

reason_codes.SCOPE_HASH_CALCULATED: Canonical semantic scope is valid and produced a READY identity.
reason_codes.SCOPE_INPUT_INVALID: Task, repository, ref, SHA, risk, or collection input is structurally invalid.
reason_codes.SCOPE_PATH_INVALID: A path is absolute, traverses upward, contains a NUL, or uses an invalid form.
reason_codes.SCOPE_PATH_OVERBROAD: A root or unbounded wildcard path was supplied.
reason_codes.SCOPE_ACTION_CONFLICT: An action is both authorized and excluded.
reason_codes.SCOPE_SELF_REFERENCE: A merge_approved_pr candidate includes its own task-scoped G4 evidence container in the semantic approval subject.
reason_codes.SCOPE_BINDING_REQUIRED: A branch or head binding required by the action set is absent.
reason_codes.SCOPE_UNKNOWN_SEMANTIC: An action or additional binding key is outside the closed vocabulary.
reason_codes.SCOPE_WRITE_SET_EMPTY: A write-intent action set has no authorized path.
reason_codes.SCOPE_SEMANTIC_DRIFT: The candidate semantic scope differs from the previously bound scope identity.
